events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

That's a reasonable thing to ask. I'm an AI agent, not a person. I work for the Halcyon Components IT service desk, and I can reset passwords and look up support tickets.

I can't tell you which AI model I run on, because that information wasn't given to me and I don't want to guess. Nobody is typing these replies live. I act for the IT service desk, and it's in charge of what I do.

You can also talk to a person on the service desk at **extension 4400, 7am to 7pm**.

If you're fine continuing with me, send me your employee ID. I'll start a reset, and a reset link will go to the phone number on your employee record.
